home.headline: Coordinate support without exchanging personal contact details
home.lead: Meeks is a chat that lets the people you support, support workers and staff from different organizations talk without exchanging contact details. No account or app is needed. Share a room URL and approve who joins to use messages, files and video calls.

story.why.title: Why we built Meeks
story.why.p1: In PAPS's support work, we sometimes accompany the people we support together with other organizations. For visits to a hospital, a welfare office or a lawyer, the person and several support workers need to confirm where to meet and when they will arrive.
story.why.p2: But exchanging support workers' personal phone numbers or social media accounts is not always appropriate. The person we support may not want to give their contact details to outside organizations. Some support workers have no work phone, and each organization may use different communication tools.
story.why.p3: Even so, we do not want the communication that support depends on to break down. Meeks grew out of these challenges on the ground.
story.uses.title: When to use it
story.uses.hospital.title: Hospital visits
story.uses.hospital.body: The person, the accompanying support worker and the staff joining at the hospital confirm the meeting place and arrival time.
story.uses.welfare.title: Welfare office visits
story.uses.welfare.body: Support workers from different organizations coordinate plans before and after the appointment.
story.uses.lawyer.title: Meetings with a lawyer
story.uses.lawyer.body: The person and support workers confirm the meeting place and what to bring.
story.uses.crossOrg.title: Support across organizations
story.uses.crossOrg.body: People who cannot share an internal tool such as Teams or Slack get a temporary place to talk.
story.share.title: Share only what communication needs
story.share.p1: With Meeks you can start talking without exchanging phone numbers or social media accounts. Joining a room requires approval from a participant. Messages, files and calls are end-to-end encrypted, and messages are not stored on the server.
story.share.p2: Meeks is a way for people seeking support and those supporting them to stay connected. We want everyone involved in support to be able to reach each other when needed, whatever their organization or device.
features.title: Why Meeks
features.e2ee.title: End-to-end encrypted
features.e2ee.body: Messages, files and calls are encrypted on your device. Not even the server operator can read them.
features.noStore.title: Nothing stays on the server
features.noStore.body: Messages are not stored on the server; participants exchange them directly, peer-to-peer. History is kept on each device and synced between participants.
features.url.title: Just send a URL
features.url.body: No account and no app to install. Share a URL, approve who joins, and you are ready.
features.files.title: Share files and photos
features.files.body: Send images, videos and documents up to 100 MB, encrypted all the way.
features.video.title: Video calls
features.video.body: Video calls right in your browser, with encrypted video and audio.
features.read.title: Read receipts
features.read.body: See who has read each message. You can even chat with people while their request to join is pending.
